item.title: Smart ring maker Oura facing US lawsuit over sleep tracking accuracy claims
item.summary: Smart ring manufacturer Oura is facing a lawsuit by American customers over the accuracy of the device’s sleep tracking features. Filed in San Francisco, the class action will allege the Oura smart ring was unable to accurately measure the signals to determine sleep quality or sleep stages.
